summary: All eleven blocking findings addressed in the canonical leaf; research/scope.md untouched. CON-EVI-030 and CON-CIT-020 (same defect): in sections/40-notable.tex the quoted clause 'and from bad it went to worse till the Flyer was a misnomer' is deleted and the breakdown is now narrated in the guide's own words, without quotation marks, from what scope.md 8.5/8.8 record (engine broke down midway between stations five miles apart and refused to turn a wheel, flagman two and a half miles afoot, Chattanooga two and a quarter hours late); the 'stopped at nearly every telegraph station' characterisation is replaced by 8.5's own Cultural-payoff wording, 'a traveller's grumble about the Exposition Flyer'. Every string now inside quotation marks in that entry comes from the collated first crop or from the King James. Beyond the literal instruction I also corrected 99-references.tex from 'read as a page image at the two crops quoted above' to 'at the crop quoted above and at the masthead block', because after the deletion only one crop is quoted and 'two' would have become a fresh miscount; 8.5's evidence state records the wording crop and the masthead as the two collated regions. CON-EVI-031: Carter v. Harris removed from the gallery entry's 'Later text and loci' and from the References list of opinions used; 'it has done that work for two centuries' re-based to 'it does that work from Everhart in 1872 to the Supreme Court in 1961', the two opinions 8.2/8.8 record as read whole. Knights of Pythias (1900), SEC (1963) and NLRB (1994) remain in the 'In the same line' list, which the finding did not ask to change, so the printed list runs past the span the turn now claims; no claim rests on them. CON-REC-001: in sections/30-commentary.tex the Gradual head sentence now reads 'The princes are read four ways, and a question stands beside the four'; the paragraph's close now sets 'a Greek reading against three Latin ones'; Godfrey of Admont is removed from the compilations sentence (now 'one compilation', Peter Lombard alone, with the Prosper/Lombard dependence caution unchanged) and given his own witnessnote as the fourth account of what the princes are, keeping the Introit bound that his Fourteenth Sunday is not the 1962 Fourteenth Sunday. The comparative phrase in that new note, 'the only one that keeps them inside the man who prays', is my own formulation of a contrast the brief's four positions support, not the brief's wording. CON-REC-002: the per-witness ordinals at 'respice in faciem Christi tui' are dropped (Arnobius, Godfrey, Theodoret) and the count is stated once before the witnesses, as the synthesis edition does, naming the six holders in the order the page prints them; all six kept and Cassiodorus's dependence on Augustine still stated. CON-REC-003: the orphaned seventeen-item Greek vice lemma paragraph is moved out from behind the Glossa ordinaria witnessnote into Chrysostom's own treatment and opened with his name. CON-CIT-021: the manufactured Commons column 1036 is replaced by the debate title 'Central Africa' in both 40-notable.tex and 99-references.tex; the Lords col. 1203 stands. CON-CIT-022: 'six psalms' becomes 'five psalms' in sections/90-scope.tex (Pss. 66, 81, 95, 98 and 100) and in sections/30-commentary.tex (five psalms, with the brief's six loci enumerated). CON-CIT-023: 'and the Revised Standard' dropped from the psalm-numbering correction box. CON-PRO-001: the seven named clauses are deleted from seven of the eight englishgap blocks in sections/05-appointed-text.tex, each block keeping its material statement about the witness; the Secret's block is untouched. At the Postcommunion I deleted the whole sentence rather than only the named clause, because removing 'The Latin phrase is left in Latin rather than rendered here' alone would have left the subjectless fragment 'and the measurement in the commentary is made on it', which is the same species of narration. The work-wide translation posture stands unchanged in Appendix: Scope and Qualifications. CON-PRO-002: the disclaiming clause is deleted at all eleven loci (30-commentary.tex at the Honorius column, Augustine on Galatians, Aquinas, Peter Lombard, Christian of Stavelot, Rabanus twice, the exposition under Bede's name, Arnobius at the Offertory and Gueranger, and 35-source-grounded-synthesis.tex at Gueranger), each keeping the material statement it hung off; the Bede sentence goes entirely. Verification: both editions were built with pdflatex from a scratch output directory with zero errors (research 61 pp., synthesis 34 pp.); the brief-synthesis labels still resolve to pages 3, 4 and 5 in both; tpt check-proper-components and tpt check-generation-metadata pass on both PDFs; and the deleted strings ('misnomer', 'telegraph', '1036', 'Carter v. Harris', 'two centuries', 'Revised Standard', 'six psalms', 'two compilations', and every CON-PRO-001/002 clause) return zero hits in both editions' rendered text. generation-metadata.tex keeps this packet's provenance values unchanged (verified field by field against the header) with the revision timestamp updated and one AIModelContribution added for this pass.
